name: Curtis Miller
bio: I’m a husband, father of two, author, and fitness coach passionate about helping busy professionals transform their bodies and lives. Over the past year, I’ve lost more than 50 pounds through discipline, nutrition, and consistent training. My mission is to help others build strength, confidence, and freedom by mastering their fitness, mindset, and daily habits.
story:
Why I Became a Coach

I became a coach because fitness changed my life. I personally lost over 50 pounds, improved my health, built more confidence, and learned that discipline in the gym carries over into every area of life. Now I help others achieve the same transformation and become the best version of themselves.

What I Believe In

I believe lasting results come from consistency, not perfection. You don’t need extreme diets or endless hours in the gym. With the right plan, accountability, and habits, anyone can build a stronger, leaner, healthier body.

What My Program Looks Like

My coaching provides personalized workouts, nutrition guidance, accountability, and ongoing support. I focus on sustainable habits that fit into real life so clients can lose fat, build muscle, and maintain their results long term.

Who My Program Is Built For

My program is designed for busy professionals, parents, and adults over 40 who want to lose weight, build strength, increase energy, and improve their confidence without spending hours in the gym.
